design_notes: The formal factorial subset is TN2-TN5 and TN10-TN13: two irrigation schedules by four actual nitrogen rates.
The SA-only experiment bundle uses one depth-wise median SH2O/SNH4/SNO3 profile; calibration continues to use observed treatment-specific initial conditions.
LAI DAP points align with FileT process sampling dates; all fixed-DAP cumulative-fruit outputs are excluded.
Water contrasts, nitrogen slopes using 0/130/271/399 kg N ha-1, and slope-difference W x N interactions are computed from paired simulations.
MDAPS is omitted because the reviewed baseline returns the DSSAT missing sentinel.
LAIXS is the simulated maximum LAI; LAIXM is measured and must not be used as a model response.
FRUITD_DAP50 is the simulated DAP at which cumulative harvested dry matter reaches 50% of its season-end value.
General genetic influence and water-nitrogen response are separate ranking domains and must not be averaged into one score.
